audit_scope.description: This batch covers EL precompile dispatch and cryptographic operations (RIPEMD-160, precompile mapping, numeric utilities, genesis), CL consensus mechanisms (attestation inclusion via EIP-7045, optimistic sync, SSZ Merkle proofs), CL/EL interfaces (optimistic sync Engine API), validator infrastructure (BLS remote signing via EIP-3030), and protocol governance (EIP-2070 Berlin hardfork, EIP-7808 tx type namespaces).

out_of_scope: Execution Layer internals beyond Engine API

el_vectors.threat: Submit malformed transactions, resource exhaustion via precompile calls with large inputs, RIP namespace type confusion (EIP-7808)
Eclipse attacks, send invalid blocks with crafted precompile-triggering transactions, genesis configuration poisoning for new nodes

cl_vectors.threat: Submit stale attestations exploiting extended inclusion window (EIP-7045), fork choice poisoning via optimistic sync, conflicting attestations

cl_vectors.entry_point: External APIs (BLS Remote Signer, checkpoint sync)
cl_vectors.threat: Compromise BLS signing service to cause slashing, provide invalid checkpoint data for optimistic sync bootstrap, forge Merkle proofs

misclassified_entities.reason: Labeled as 'Proof System Caller' but described as 'Internal component requesting generalized index computation'. This is an internal CL component, not an external entity.
Internal EVM gas calculation component. Not external to the system boundary.
Internal fee market calculator component. Part of EL internals.
Internal cryptographic operation (e.g., BLAKE2). Not external to EL.
Described as 'Validation Component' for Ethash DAG. Internal EL validation, not an external entity.
Internal request handling pipeline within the BLS signer. Not an external entity.
Governance process participants, not a runtime entity that sends data into the system.

trusted_external_entities.name: Contract/EOA via EVM CALL to Precompile
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Any contract or EOA can invoke precompiles via EVM call opcodes. Input data is arbitrary and untrusted. Gas metering is the primary protection against abuse.

trusted_external_entities.name: Merkle Proof Provider via P2P / Light Client Protocol
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P light client protocol (single and multi-item Merkle proofs)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External peers providing Merkle proofs are unauthenticated. Proofs must be cryptographically verified against a trusted root. Malicious peers can provide forged proofs.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter via JSON-RPC
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: JSON-RPC eth_sendRawTransaction (includes RIP namespace types 0x40-0x7f per EIP-7808)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Public RPC endpoint, no authentication. Transactions may use RIP-reserved type range which must be correctly identified and routed.

trusted_external_entities.name: L2 Rollup via RIP Transaction Types
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Transaction type namespace 0x40-0x7f (EIP-7808 RIP reserved range)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: L2 rollups define their own transaction types in the reserved range. L1 nodes must not process these as EIP types. No authentication of RIP governance decisions at the protocol level.

trusted_external_entities.name: Attesting Validator via P2P Gossip
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Beacon chain P2P gossip (attestation and aggregate subnets, EIP-7045 extended window)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Validators submit attestations over unauthenticated P2P gossip. Extended inclusion window (EIP-7045) increases the time window for potentially malicious attestations. All attestations require full validation.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Proposer via P2P Network
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Beacon block gossip (includes attestation inclusion per EIP-7045)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Block proposers are validators but blocks arrive over unauthenticated P2P. Proposers select which attestations to include within the extended window.

trusted_external_entities.name: Gossip Network Peer via P2P
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P gossip protocol (attestation propagation, EIP-7045 extended gossip conditions)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P peers are unauthenticated. They may propagate stale or malicious attestations. Extended gossip window increases exposure to attestation flooding.

trusted_external_entities.name: Execution Engine via Engine API
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Engine API (newPayload, forkchoiceUpdated) for optimistic sync payload validation
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Authenticated via JWT between CL and EL. However, a buggy or compromised EL could return incorrect VALID/INVALIDATED responses, leading to fork choice poisoning or following invalid chains.

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Peers via Beacon Block Gossip (Optimistic Sync)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P beacon block gossip (blocks imported optimistically before EL validation)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peers providing beacon blocks are unauthenticated. Optimistic sync imports blocks before execution validation, creating a window where fork choice may include invalid blocks.

trusted_external_entities.name: Malicious Block Producer via P2P
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P beacon block gossip (crafted blocks with invalid execution payloads)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Attacker crafts blocks with unreferenceable parent hashes to trigger false justification and poison fork choice. SAFE_SLOTS_TO_IMPORT_OPTIMISTICALLY (128) provides mitigation window.

trusted_external_entities.name: Genesis Configuration File via Filesystem
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Filesystem read of assets/ directory JSON configuration
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Genesis file is loaded from local filesystem, implying some trust in the deployment environment. However, content must be validated (hex parsing, address format) as it could be corrupted or tampered.

trusted_external_entities.name: Validator Client via HTTP API
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: HTTP POST /sign/:identifier (EIP-3030 BLS Remote Signer API)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: HTTP requests arrive over the network. Even with TLS, the signer must authenticate requests, validate BLS domain, check rate limits. Unauthorized signing could cause slashing.

trusted_external_entities.name: HSM or Secrets Manager
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Key retrieval API (EIP-3030 BLS key storage backend)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: HSM/secrets manager is a controlled dependency with authenticated access, but key integrity depends on correct HSM configuration. A misconfigured HSM could expose keys.

trusted_external_entities.name: Untrusted Network for BLS Signer
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Network layer carrying HTTP requests to BLS remote signer (EIP-3030)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Without TLS, the network exposes signing requests and responses to eavesdropping and MITM attacks. Even with TLS, network-level DoS is possible.

trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer via P2P Block Propagation
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P devp2p block propagation (fork-dependent validation rules, EIP-2070 Berlin)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peer nodes broadcasting blocks are unauthenticated. Blocks must be validated against the correct rule set (pre/post fork). Incorrect fork detection could accept invalid blocks.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Input data is arbitrary bytes. Gas metering (GAS_RIPEMD160 + GAS_RIPEMD160_WORD * words) must accurately reflect computation cost to prevent DoS. Output is deterministic 32-byte padded hash.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: EVM CALL to precompile address range (0x01-0x11)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: All precompile inputs are untrusted. Each precompile must independently validate input format and charge appropriate gas before performing computation.
Proof must be verified against a trusted root. Proof length must match generalized index depth. Reconstructed root must exactly equal expected root. SHA-256 collision resistance is assumed.
Helper indices must be computed independently from provided data. Proof length must equal helper_indices length. All leaf positions must be valid for the SSZ type schema.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: JSON-RPC eth_sendRawTransaction with EIP-7808 type namespace check
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Full transaction validation required. Transaction type byte must be checked against RIP range (0x40-0x7f) to prevent misrouting. EIP-2718 envelope format must be validated.
L1 nodes must reject or ignore RIP transaction types. Namespace boundary (0x40-0x7f inclusive) must be strictly enforced to prevent type collision between EIP and RIP definitions.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Beacon chain attestation processing (EIP-7045 extended inclusion window)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Attestation slot must be verified against extended window (up to last slot of epoch N+1). Target epoch must be current or previous. Signature must be valid. Duplicate attestations must be rejected.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: P2P attestation gossip validation (EIP-7045 extended gossip conditions)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Attestation must pass extended gossip window check before propagation. Stale attestations (beyond epoch N+1) must be dropped. Rate limiting may be needed to prevent gossip flooding.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Beacon block validation (attestation inclusion per EIP-7045)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Block validator must verify all included attestations are within the extended inclusion window. TIMELY_TARGET_FLAG is set without inclusion_delay constraint for valid attestations.

JWT authentication validates channel integrity but not payload correctness. CL must handle all three responses (VALID, NOT_VALIDATED, INVALIDATED) correctly. latestValidHash must be used to scope invalidation. SAFE_SLOTS_TO_IMPORT_OPTIMISTICALLY (128) provides merge block protection.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Beacon block import (optimistic sync state machine)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Blocks imported optimistically are added to optimistic_roots set. Validator duties MUST be restricted while head is optimistic (no DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER, DOMAIN_BEACON_ATTESTER, DOMAIN_SYNC_COMMITTEE signing).

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Fork choice via optimistic sync (fork choice poisoning attack vector)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: SAFE_SLOTS_TO_IMPORT_OPTIMISTICALLY provides 128-slot window for honest chain to justify. Honest chain with higher justified checkpoint must override poisoned store. CLI override available as last resort.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Genesis block initialization (assets/ directory JSON load)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: File content must be parsed and validated: hex values checked for format, addresses validated as 20-byte B_20, balances validated as U256. Chain_id must match expected network. Corrupted or tampered genesis files must cause initialization failure.

Request must be authenticated. BLS domain must be validated (beacon_proposer, beacon_attester, randao only). Key identifier must exist. JSON body must contain all required fields. Slashing protection must be enforced externally. Rate limiting required for DoS protection.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: BLS private key retrieval from secure storage (EIP-3030)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: HSM must be properly configured with access controls. Keys must be zeroized from memory after signing. Physical access to signer node must be restricted.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Network transport for BLS signer HTTP API (EIP-3030)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: TLS/HTTPS must be used to prevent eavesdropping on signatures and signing requests. Without encryption, signatures could be intercepted enabling replay or analysis attacks.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Block validation with fork-dependent rules (EIP-2070 Berlin activation)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Block number must be checked against fork activation threshold. Correct rule set (pre-Berlin vs post-Berlin) must be applied. Applying wrong rules could accept invalid blocks or reject valid ones.
